title: Volume of Prisms and Pyramids
seo_title: Grade 7 Volume of Prisms and Pyramids Worksheets (TEKS 7.9A, STAAR)
standard_text: 7.8A model the relationship between the volume of a rectangular prism and a rectangular pyramid having both congruent bases and heights and connect that relationship to the formulas; 7.8B explain verbally and symbolically the relationship between the volume of a triangular prism and a triangular pyramid having both congruent bases and heights and connect that relationship to the formulas; 7.9A solve problems involving the volume of rectangular prisms, triangular prisms, rectangular pyramids, and triangular pyramids
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 volume worksheets for Texas TEKS 7.8A, 7.8B and 7.9A: rectangular and triangular prisms, rectangular and triangular pyramids, V = Bh and V = ⅓Bh, and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Prism: V = Bh. Pyramid: V = ⅓Bh.
key_sub: Three pyramids fill a prism with the same base and height.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Volume of any prism: V = Bh, where B is the area of the base and h is the height.
  • For a triangular prism, B = ½ × base × height of the triangle.
  • Volume of a pyramid: V = ⅓Bh. It is one third of the prism with the same base and height.
  • Volume is in cubic units, such as cm³ or ft³.

Examples

Example

Rectangular pyramid: base 6 in. by 4 in., height 9 in.

B = 24

⅓ × 24 × 9

Answer: 72 in³

Example

Triangular prism: base 5, height 4, length 10

B = ½ × 5 × 4 = 10

10 × 10

Answer: 100 cubic units

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting the ⅓ for a pyramidA pyramid holds one third of the prism.
Forgetting the ½ for a triangle baseB = ½ × b × h for a triangle.
Using a slant heightUse the height that is perpendicular to the base.

items.q: Find the volume of the rectangular prism (5 cm by 3 cm by 4 cm).
items.e: V = l × w × h = 5 × 3 × 4 = 60 cm³. Not 94: that is the surface area.

items.q: A triangular prism has a triangle base with base 6 in. and height 4 in. The prism is 10 in. long. What is its volume?

sets.title: Prisms and pyramids with the same base and height

items.q: Which formula gives the volume of a pyramid with base area B and height h?
items.e: A pyramid is one third of a prism with the same base and height: V = ⅓Bh.

items.q: A pyramid and a prism have the same base and the same height. How many pyramids full of sand fill the prism?
items.e: The volume of a pyramid is ⅓ of the prism with the same base and height, so 3 pyramids fill it.

items.q: A triangular prism has a volume of 45 ft³. A triangular pyramid has the same base and height. What is the volume of the pyramid?
items.e: A pyramid is ⅓ of the prism: 45 ÷ 3 = 15 ft³.

items.q: A pyramid has a volume of 72 cm³. A prism has the same base and height. What is the volume of the prism?
items.e: A prism holds 3 times as much: 3 × 72 = 216 cm³.

items.q: A pyramid has a volume of 30 cm³. A prism has the same base and height. What is the volume of the prism?
items.e: A prism holds 3 times as much: 3 × 30 = 90 cm³.

items.q: A pyramid has a volume of 45 cm³. A prism has the same base and height. What is the volume of the prism?
